False positive reported by Dependency-Check for Spring Security 7.2.0.
CVE-2026-47842 affects Spring Security 7.1.0 and earlier affected release lines; the official advisory lists 7.1.1 as the fixed version. Spring Security 7.2.0 is not affected.
Advisory: https://spring.io/security/cve-2026-47842
Re-evaluate when updating the resolved dependency version or when vulnerability metadata is corrected.
